newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wuhan Boiler expects B share offer in first half.
newsitem.headline: Wuhan Boiler expects B share offer in first half.

text.p: Wuhan Boiler Co Ltd expects to launch an offer of B shares worth $30 million in the first half of 1997, with the number of shares subject to the issue pricing, which has yet to be fixed, a company spokesman said on Monday.

Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co Ltd has been named as the offer's domestic main underwriter, with Nomura International (H.K.) Ltd the international coordinator, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

Wuhan Boiler, which has not decided where to apply to list the B shares for foreign investors, is one of 33 firms recently chosen by the Securities Commission of the State Council as candidates to list B shares.
The company, based in Wuhan, capital of central Hubei province, makes boilers for domestic power plants.
If the B share offer goes through, the firm would use the share proceeds to revamp production facilities and technology, the official said. He gave no more details.
